transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you here today?

Well... my wife wanted me to come in. Things have just been a bit tense at home lately. Ever since her dad moved in with us, I don't know, I've just been... snapping at her over stupid little things around the house. And I've been putting off a lot of paperwork and jobs I usually take care of. Just... can't seem to get my head quiet. Even when I go out to my workshop or try to get some fishing in, it's just... noisy in my head.
Have you ever had a period like this before, where you felt overwhelmed and had trouble focusing on tasks?
No. Not really. I usually just... handle things. Never had an issue getting my work done before. It's just lately.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest in things you usually enjoy, like your workshop or fishing?
Not really losing interest, I guess. I still want to do them. It's just... hard to actually enjoy it right now with everything else going on.
Have you been feeling more irritable or angry lately, even about small things that normally wouldn’t bother you?
Yeah, I suppose so. Like I mentioned earlier... just snapping at my wife over dumb stuff. I just don't have a lot of patience right now. That's about it.
Have you had a period where you felt down, hopeless, or lost pleasure in most activities for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
No, not like that. I mean, I'm stressed, but... I don't feel hopeless. Just... overwhelmed, I guess.
Have you noticed that you feel more tired or have less energy lately, even when you're not doing much?
Not really. I mean... my energy seems fine. I haven't really noticed being extra tired or anything like that.
Have you found yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or feeling like you're physically slowed down?
No, I don't think so. Uh... physically, I feel fine. Just moving like normal, I guess.

Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, extremely confident, or overly energetic, where people around you noticed a change in your behavior or thought you were acting out of character?
No... I don't think so. I haven't ever felt unusually high or anything like that. Just normal, I guess.
Have you found yourself doing things more slowly or feeling unmotivated to get things done, even tasks that are important to you?
Not really. Um... if something needs to get done, I just do it. I haven't noticed being slower.
